t: Titan TTB874CSW 1200W 165mm electric circular saw engineered for consistent, powerful timber cutting on site and in the workshop. Features a robust, corded design ideal for general construction, roofing, and flooring tasks requiring fast, accurate straight cuts in various wood materials. The 1200W motor delivers a no-load speed of 5000rpm, providing effective performance for a maximum cutting depth of 55mm at 90°, whilst the robust steel base and aluminium guard offer enhanced stability and safety. The 240V circular saw also features a rubber-coated grip to ensure comfortable handling during extended use, ideal as a reliable choice for trade professionals. Supplied with parallel guide for accurate ripping, hey key and 24-tooth TCT blade.
